Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Intake manifold pressure sensor

  • Fault: Engine stalling at idle.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty or fouled intake manifold pressure sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the intake manifold pressure sensor and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The faulty sensor was found to be fouled and, following its replacement, the fault was permanently resolved.
    The component is located between the engine and the passenger compartment, on the passenger side, at the top of the engine compartment, connected to the intake manifold.

    The estimated time required for the repair is approximately 0.4 h.
